mapper.select: SELECT '期初余额'summary,period_end_balance balance from book_subject_period where subject_id = #{subjectId} and year_period = #{currentPeriod}

select.foreach: SELECT '本期合计'summary,#{date} yearPeriod, IFNULL(SUM(bvr.debit),0) debit,IFNULL(SUM(bvr.credit),0) credit FROM `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv on bv.voucher_id = bvr.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id where bvr.del_flag = '0' and bv.book_id = #{params.bookId} and bs.code LIKE CONCAT('',(SELECT code from book_subject where subject_id = #{params.subjectId} and book_id = #{params.bookId}) ,'%') and bv.year_period = #{date} union all SELECT '本年累计'summary,#{date} yearPeriod,IFNULL(SUM(bvr.debit),0) debit,IFNULL(SUM(bvr.credit),0) credit FROM `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv on bv.voucher_id = bvr.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id where bvr.del_flag = '0' and bv.book_id = #{params.bookId} and bs.code LIKE CONCAT('',(SELECT code from book_subject where subject_id = #{params.subjectId} and book_id = #{params.bookId}) ,'%') and bv.year_period <= #{date} and YEAR(year_period) = YEAR(#{date})
